## Working session summary

All seven workflows are green on head `dee300c6`, the working tree is clean, and PR #978 is ready and mergeable.

The two failures on the previous head had a single shared cause: extracting the release argv into `scripts/invoke-create-github-release.sh` moved the `--self-hosting-ledger` flag out of `release.yml`, and `tests/unit/specification/self_hosting_metric.rs:456` still asserted on the workflow text (`assertion failed: workflow.contains("--self-hosting-ledger")`). Both `Test (ubuntu-latest)` and `Code Coverage` run the same suite, so both went red. The assertion now follows the logic into the script and additionally pins that the workflow reaches the release step through it.

I also made `gate_script_behaves_correctly_for_every_conclusion` skip when `jq` is absent off CI, while keeping a missing `jq` fatal on CI — it was panicking on developer machines without it.

- PR: https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pull/978
- Fix commit: `dee300c6`

Still deliberately out of scope and stated in the PR body: recreating the 11 missing GitHub Releases (v0.326.2…v0.333.0) and the ~25 source files in the 900–1000-line warning band.
